content:
Early voting and absentee ballots in Webb County show Democratic candidates ahead in the governor's race and in three state legislative races, according to unofficial totals reported on election night, Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

These totals cover Webb County only. They do not include Election Day votes, and they do not represent statewide results or full legislative district results. No winner has been called in these races based on these early totals alone.

Texas Governor — Webb County

Gina Hinojosa (D): 31,861 votes, 70.26 percent. Greg Abbott (R): 12,800 votes, 28.23 percent. Pat Dixon (L): 655 votes, 1.44 percent. Write-in votes: 31, 0.07 percent. Total: 45,347 votes. Hinojosa leads Abbott in Webb County by 19,061 votes in the early totals.

Texas Senate District 21 — Webb County

Judith Zaffirini (D): 33,757 votes, 76.28 percent. Julie Dahlberg (R): 10,498 votes, 23.72 percent. Total: 44,255 votes. Zaffirini leads by 23,259 votes in the early totals.

Texas House District 42 — Webb County

Richard Peña Raymond (D): 24,352 votes, 72.37 percent. Teresa Johnson-Hernandez (R): 9,296 votes, 27.63 percent. Total: 33,648 votes. Raymond leads by 15,056 votes in the early totals.

Texas House District 80 — Webb County

Cecilia Castellano (D): 7,654 votes, 74.03 percent. Don McLaughlin (R): 2,685 votes, 25.97 percent. Total: 10,339 votes. Castellano leads by 4,969 votes in the early totals.

Election night results in Texas are unofficial until counties canvass and certify them.

Sources: Webb County Elections Office early voting and absentee totals reported November 3, 2026; Associated Press Webb County governor results.

Webb Watch 956
excerpt: Unofficial early voting and absentee totals in Webb County show Gina Hinojosa leading Greg Abbott for governor, 31,861 to 12,800, with Democratic candidates also ahead in Senate District 21 and House Districts 42 and 80. Election Day votes are not yet included.
title: Webb County early voting: Hinojosa leads Abbott for governor, Democrats ahead in state races
